resources.string: Encri Files has not been let into your vault yet, or was let in before this version was installed. encri asks you, on its own screen, what this app may see.
Other apps are not allowed into the vault: that is turned off in encri. encri can turn it on when it asks you about this app.
encri is not installed. Encri Files shows what is in an encri vault, so it needs encri on this phone.
The encri on this phone is not signed by a key this app trusts, so this app will not talk to it. The SHA-256 of its certificate is %1$s.
The encri on this phone is too old for this app. It speaks version %1$d of the protocol apps use to reach it. Update encri.
This folder is no longer in the vault.
This folder could not be listed.

When this is on, Encri Files shows a small picture of each photo and video in a folder. encri makes each picture and hands it to this app, which keeps it in memory only, never on the phone\'s storage, and drops them all when the vault locks. When it is off, this app asks encri for no pictures at all and shows names alone. This changes Encri Files alone: what other apps\' file pickers show is set in encri.

When this is off, Android blocks screenshots and screen recordings of Encri Files, keeps it off any screen you cast to, and shows a blank card for it among your recent apps. When it is on, anything this app shows, such as the names and previews of what is in your vault, can be captured, and a screenshot is kept in your photos, outside the vault, where photo backups and other apps can reach it. This changes Encri Files alone: encri\'s own screens always block screenshots.
This cannot be undone. A backup encri made before now may still hold a copy.
Everything in the folder is deleted with it. This cannot be undone. A backup encri made before now may still hold a copy.
Moving “%1$s”. Go to the folder it should go into, and move it there.
encri has not let this app change anything here. “Allow more in encri”, in the menu, asks it.
Something with that name is already there.
A folder cannot go inside itself, and the folder this app was let into cannot be moved.
The folder this app was let into cannot be deleted from here.
encri has not let this app do that. “Allow more in encri”, in the menu, asks it.
It is no longer in the vault.
The phone has run out of space.
Other apps are not allowed into the vault: that is turned off in encri.
encri ended the session. Try again.

The copy is not encrypted. It goes to a place you choose next, outside the vault, where the app that keeps that place can read it, and so can anything that app backs up or syncs to. Encri Files cannot take it back, and deleting the document from the vault later does not delete the copy.
No app on this phone can choose files.
Nothing was copied: Encri Files was closed while you chose. Choose again.
Keep Encri Files open until it finishes: Android may pause or stop it while another app is in front.
Nothing was copied into the vault.
Unlock the vault to see which were not copied, and why.

plurals.name: left_unfinished
plurals.item: One is left in the vault with “(unfinished)” in its name: delete it, and copy that file again.
%d are left in the vault with “(unfinished)” in their names: delete them, and copy those files again.

resources.string: The originals are still where they were, and not encrypted: copying a file in does not remove it. Delete them there if they should be in the vault alone.
Nothing was copied: the files need %1$s, and the vault can take %2$s more.
The file made at the place you chose is left there, empty or part-written: delete it there.
The place you chose holds less than was written, so the copy there is not whole. Delete it there, and copy it out again.
The app it came from gives it no name.
The app it came from would not hand it over.
encri stopped handing it over, as it does when the vault locks or this app\'s access ends.
The place you chose would not take it.
The folder is no longer in the vault.
Encri Files was not let in.
encri would not hand this document to another app.
No app on this phone opens %1$s.
